When I originally saw the trailer, I was pretty hyped. Of course that hype completely evaporated when I saw the pricetag.

So here's "making sense" of what's going on:

For those who have never owned Elite Dangerous, and choose to buy it, pre-ordering New Horizons is $44.

For those of us (including myself) who preordered the game before it was released, or already own Elite Dangerous to get New Horizons is $34.

But here's the problem (archived store page):

"Elite Dangerous: Horizons includes all Elite Dangerous content to date, and all players will continue to fly together in the same galaxy. Existing Elite Dangerous players receive a £10 loyalty discount off the price of Elite Dangerous: Horizons..."

This means that people who have never owned Elite Dangerous can preorder New Horizons right now, and get the base game AND the expansion pack for $44.

Meanwhile people who already bought the game before this expansion, for $50-$60 have to spend $34 to get the expansion pack.

TL;DR:

  • People just coming can buy the expansion pack & the game for $44.

  • People who have owned the game have to spend an additional $34 on top of their original payment ($50-$60) for the game to get the content.
How New Horizons screws people who already own the game
